title: Convert Arch to namtor, namtor-gnome, and namtor-kde split packages
summary: The Arch PKGBUILD has been converted from a monolithic package to a split-package build using pkgbase=namtor with three pkgname entries: namtor (core), namtor-gnome, and namtor-kde. makepkg --printsrcinfo confirms the three-package structure with correct per-package metadata. The core package owns the daemon, worker, CLI, PAM module, systemd units, sysusers, tmpfiles, D-Bus, polkit, manifests, models, licences, lifecycle helper, and SBOM — it is headless-safe with no desktop runtime deps. The GNOME package owns the enroll-wizard binary, .desktop, .metainfo.xml, and .svg, depending on namtor (exact version) + gtk4 + libadwaita. The KDE package owns the KCM QML module (CMake-installed) plus .desktop, .metainfo.xml, and .svg, depending on namtor (exact version) + qt6-base + kirigami + kcoreaddons. All sha256sums are pinned (no SKIP). The core package's install hook (namtor.install) delegates to the shared lifecycle helper. Desktop packages have no install hooks — pacman's alpm hooks (desktop-database.hook, gtk-icon-cache.hook) handle .desktop/icon cache updates automatically after the transaction. No file conflicts exist between the three packages (verified by staging each into separate DESTDIRs and checking for overlapping paths).

namtor.pkgdesc: IR face authentication — daemon, PAM module, CLI, models (headless-safe)
namtor.staging: stage.sh --package core + model archive extraction + licence pre-write

namtor-gnome.pkgdesc: Nam-tor GNOME enrollment wizard and settings (GTK4/libadwaita)
namtor-gnome.install: none (no hook — alpm hooks handle desktop/icon caches)

namtor-kde.pkgdesc: Nam-tor KDE Plasma 6 KCM — system settings module (Qt6/KF6)
namtor-kde.install: none (no hook — alpm hooks handle desktop/icon caches)

dep_isolation.gnome_no_qt_kde: PASS — namtor-gnome depends array contains no qt6-base, kirigami, or kcoreaddons
dep_isolation.kde_no_gtk_libadwaita: PASS — namtor-kde depends array contains no gtk4 or libadwaita
dep_isolation.core_no_desktop: PASS — namtor depends array contains no gtk4, libadwaita, qt6-base, kirigami, or kcoreaddons
dep_isolation.exact_version_pin: PASS — both desktop packages depend on 'namtor=$pkgver' (exact version, not >= or unbounded)

file_conflict_check.method: stage.sh --package core|gnome|kde into three separate DESTDIRs, collect file paths, check for intersections via comm
file_conflict_check.note: Shared directories (/usr/share/applications, /usr/share/metainfo, /usr/share/icons) are owned by core in the manifest; GNOME and KDE each own only their own files dropped into them. The KDE CMake install also writes desktop/metainfo/icon files, but stage.sh --package kde overwrites them with identical content from the manifest (same source files).

lifecycle_helper.core_install_hook: namtor.install delegates all phases (post_install, pre_upgrade, post_upgrade, pre_remove, post_remove) to /usr/share/namtor/lifecycle.sh
lifecycle_helper.desktop_hooks: none — namtor-gnome and namtor-kde have no install hooks. pacman's alpm hooks (desktop-database.hook, gtk-update-icon-cache.hook) run after the full transaction, covering .desktop and icon files installed by the desktop packages.
lifecycle_helper.pam_default_off: PASS — core post_install never edits /etc/pam.d (lifecycle.sh post-install does not call namtor-pam-edit)

regression_checks.test_install_default_off_sh: PASS — 19/19 (namtor.install unchanged; still delegates to lifecycle.sh)
regression_checks.test_lifecycle_sh: PASS — 38/38 (namtor.install arch hook delegation still verified)

files_not_modified: packaging/arch/namtor.install — already correct for core-only (delegates to lifecycle.sh, no desktop-specific content); no changes needed for split packages
files_not_created: packaging/arch/namtor-gnome.install — not needed; desktop packages have no hooks (alpm handles .desktop/icon caches)
